description: Show the upstream MCP URL, read-only flag, the account plan, whether writes are allowed (canWrite) with a plain-language writeAccess reason, and the live /users/profile response for the OAuth-authenticated user. Good first call to confirm auth and whether create/generate/render tools will work (free accounts are read-only over the MCP). If not signed in, it returns a 'run login' error — use the `login` tool.
name: whoami
title: Who am I
